# netskope_rbac_label (Resource)

RBACLabel Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_rbac_label" "my_rbaclabel" {
  color     = "...my_color..."
  name      = "...my_name..."
  parent_id = "33fdb577-9aee-4e4c-a3fe-d375ff9e3f17"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label name (required)

### Optional

- `color` (String) Label color as hex code (e.g.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent label UUID for hierarchy (up to 4 levels)

### Read-Only

- `label_id` (String) Label UUID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_rbac_label.my_netskope_rbac_label
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_rbac_label.my_netskope_rbac_label "..."
```
